title: Two contractors booked for the same job
situation: Blocked bath waste, landlord approved. The system log shows 'Provider assignment timed out', then a retry, then 'Maintenance provider assigned' twice with two different firms. Both firms email confirming visits on Wednesday, one at 9am and one at 2pm. The tenant asks which one is coming.
trap: Each confirmation on its own looks fine. The duplicate is only visible by reading the two provider names.
hidden_truth: A retry created a duplicate booking.

rubric.required: Keep one contractor and cancel the other with an apology, then tell the tenant which firm is coming and when. Hold for the visit.
acceptable: Ask the tenant which slot suits before cancelling the other.
optional: Record the duplicate assignment as a system fault.
prohibited: Asking the landlord to approve again.
critical: Telling the tenant both will attend.
